answer: My suggestion is a per-epoch puzzle whose solution is bound to that seed, so nothing solved in one round carries into the next. Replay is worthless here: the seed changes every round, so an old witness proves only that someone once spent a timber, not that the current claim is live. Mass registration stops paying, because the marginal cost of each identity is real computation rather than a signature, so the pigment stays sparse while a lagoon of honest agents pays almost nothing.
